system.name: Uğur Hukuk ajan sistemi (simulated)
system.description: Five agents help a small Istanbul law firm (two lawyers, one trainee, one secretary) with due-diligence reports on Turkish targets for German and Dutch clients and with legal opinions on workplace accidents and negligent homicide. An intake agent reads the firm's Gmail, files attachments to Google Drive and checks conflicts with OpenAI. An OCR/translation agent sends scanned German/Dutch documents unmasked to Google Gemini (free tier). A screening agent searches Turkish and international sanctions lists and the web for officers and shareholders and gives each person a red/amber/green label with Claude. A drafting agent writes reports and opinions from Kalkan-masked text with OpenAI or Anthropic and a Supabase vector store. A sending agent emails approved drafts to clients, and in urgent cases emails a 'pre-draft, pending lawyer approval' without a lawyer having read it.
